args.query: Flask REST API with Flask-SQLAlchemy models and marshmallow schema validation

results.title: Flask API with Flask-SQLAlchemy and marshmallow-sqlalchemy, validation errors as 422
results.summary: A Flask JSON API that loads and dumps SQLAlchemy models through SQLAlchemyAutoSchema, returns validation errors as 422, and is tested offline with the Flask test client on in-memory sqlite.

results.title: Flask-SQLAlchemy models with Flask-Migrate upgrades on sqlite in tests
results.summary: Define Flask-SQLAlchemy models, version the schema with Flask-Migrate, and test upgrade, downgrade and model/migration drift offline on a temporary sqlite file.

results.title: Flask 3 app factory + Flask-SQLAlchemy
results.summary: Flask application factory with Flask-SQLAlchemy 3, a JSON API and pytest fixtures using an in-memory database.

results.title: Flask API args parsed and validated with webargs and marshmallow
results.summary: Flask routes that parse query strings and JSON bodies through marshmallow schemas via webargs, with JSON 422 validation errors, tested offline with the Flask test client.

results.title: Flask-Login sessions with Flask-SQLAlchemy users and werkzeug password hashing
results.summary: Login, login_required redirects, logout and a user_loader built on db.session.get, with the User model in SQLite memory and tests run through the Flask test client.

results.title: marshmallow-dataclass schemas: nested load, dump and validation
results.summary: Generate marshmallow schemas from dataclasses to load, dump and validate nested records, including typed nested objects, field renaming and path-aware ValidationErrors.

results.title: marshmallow-oneofschema polymorphic nested schemas
results.summary: A OneOfSchema discriminated union over nested dataclass schemas that loads and dumps polymorphic payloads, with tests covering type dispatch and its sharp edges.

results.title: Flask-WTF forms with custom validators, CSRF on and off in tests
results.summary: A Flask-WTF form with a reusable custom WTForms validator, rendered errors, and CSRF protection, tested offline with the Flask test client: CSRF disabled in the test config, then enforced.

results.title: Flask 3 + Flask-JWT-Extended access and refresh tokens
results.summary: Login, protected routes, refresh tokens and custom claims in Flask 3 using Flask-JWT-Extended, with an app factory.

results.title: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2 CRUD with dependency-injected sessions
results.summary: FastAPI routes backed by SQLAlchemy 2.x typed models, a per-request session dependency, and TestClient tests on SQLite.
